claim: Training on pure mechanism vertices permits recovery on intermediate convex-combination mechanism states not seen during training.
verification_rule: The exact full estimator is trained only on pure vertices; all non-vertex evaluation rows are explicitly counted, and five-seed mean correlation on the 0-to-2-to-4 path must be within 0.05 of 0.945.
negative_control: Time permutation must reduce mean correlation below 0.50 and exit 1.
